description_en: Sends a user message to a specified session or cancels a session
description_zh: 向指定会话发送用户消息或取消会话
kebab_example: aliyun dms send-chat-message --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --session-id sess_000 --agent-id agent_000 --message what_can_you_do0 --message-type primary --reply-to 0 --quoted-message '{"version":"v0"}' --question '请提供计算GMV的口径。' --data-source '{"DataSourceType":"remote_data_center","Database":"test_db","Permission":{"Tables":[{"TableName":"sample_table","RequiredRowFilter":"region_=_east","AllowedColumns":["my_column_1"]}]},"Tables":["my_table"],"DmsInstanceId":"12000000","DmsDatabaseId":"23000000","FileId":"350000","DbName":"000000","RegionId":"cn-hangzhou","DataSourceId":"123","Engine":"mysql","Location":"localhost"}' --session-config CustomAgentStage=example-string Mode=ANALYSIS CustomAgentId=example-string EnableSearch=false SkipAskHuman=true SkipPlan=true Language=ENGLISH SkipSqlConfirm=false KbUuidList=dasd000cc211 McpServerIds=2q1tu9000000000006uttu2nw SkipWebReportConfirm=true ReportWaterMark=示例水印 PlanMode=disable --parent-session-id 20qrliuoo7p2vlsfg00000 --data-sources '[{"DataSourceType":"remote_data_center","Database":"test_db","Permission":{"Tables":[{"TableName":"sample_table","RequiredRowFilter":"region_=_east","AllowedColumns":["my_column_1"]}]},"Tables":["my_table"],"DmsInstanceId":"24800000","DmsDatabaseId":"1230000","FileId":"f-4w0000000","DbName":"mydatabase","RegionId":"cn-hangzhou","DataSourceId":"123","Engine":"mysql","Location":"localhost"}]' --task-config '{"ReportConfig":{"ReportTheme":"default","ReportType":"WebReport","ReportPrompt":"generate_a_report"}}' --workspace-id c1p71ne000baexrt3o --user-oss-bucket my-bucket --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendChatMessage

parameters.help_en: The Data Management unit you are currently in. If you select an analytics database, this information is used to correctly connect to your Data Management instance through Data Management. You can go to the DAS console to view your current Data Management unit. If you are a user of Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com), set this parameter to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 您当前所在的DMS单元。若您选择分析数据库，该信息将用于后续通过DMS正确连接到您的DMS实例。您可前往DMS控制台查看您当前所在的DMS单元，若您是阿里云中国站用户，可以直接填入cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: dms_unit

parameters.help_en: The session ID. This parameter is required. You can obtain the SessionId by calling the CreateAgentSession operation
parameters.help_zh: 会话 ID，必须字段。您可以通过CreateAgentSession获取SessionId
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. This parameter is required. You can obtain the current AgentId from the response of the CreateAgentSession operation. Agent resources have a lifecycle, so the AgentId you need to specify may change with each request
parameters.help_zh: AgentId，必填。您可通过CreateAgentSession接口的返回值获取当前的AgentID。Agent资源存在生命周期，因此您每次请求需要填入的AgentID可能变化
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The message content to send to the agent
parameters.help_zh: 本次向Agent发送的消息内容
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_zh:
消息类型，默认为 `[primary]`。  

常规情况下，和Agent交互，消息类型为 `[primary]`

当该消息为响应Agent的Human-in-Loop问题时，类型应当是`[additional]`

当该消息是要触发一次报告绘制时，类型应当是 `[report]`

当该消息是要取消当前会话时，类型应当是`[cancel]`
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.help_zh:
重要

当本消息是回复Agent消息（如：Agent通过 ASK_HUMAN进行问题澄清），则reply_to应当精确传入这条Agent消息携带的 Checkpoint 序号。若本消息无针对性的回复，如分析完成后要求Agent进一步深度分析，则 reply_to 可不填入或者填入"0"。  

该字段会影响Agent决策如何处理该消息，若传递错误可能导致分析效果不及预期
parameters.name: reply_to

parameters.help_en: The quoted content. This parameter is typically used when interacting with the agent
parameters.help_zh: 传入当前引用内容，通常在与Agent交互时使用
parameters.name: quoted_message

parameters.help_en: The specific question that the agent asks the user through Human-in-Loop. This parameter is required when the message type is `additional`
parameters.help_zh: 当消息类型为`additional`时为必须字段，传入Agent通过Human-in-Loop向用户提问的具体问题
parameters.name: question

element_fields.help_zh: 权限约束规则生效的表名
element_fields.name: table_name

element_fields.help_en: The list of columns that are allowed to be queried in the current table. If this parameter is not specified, all columns can be queried. If this parameter is specified, SQL statements that exceed the allowed scope are blocked. For example, syntax such as SELECT * is blocked. To ensure the analysis effectiveness of DataAgent, avoid specifying columns that exceed the allowed scope in the prompts, knowledge, or instructions modules of DataAgent. Otherwise, SQL statements without the required permissions are generated and blocked, which reduces the analysis speed and effectiveness of DataAgent
element_fields.help_zh: 当前表允许查询的字段列表。若不填表示都可以查询。若填写，超过允许范围的SQL将会被禁止执行，如类似SELECT * 的语法将会被禁止。为了保证DataAgent分析效果，请注意DataAgent的提示词、知识、指示等模块尽量不要给出超过范围的字段，以免生成无权限SQL被禁止执行，导致降低DataAgent分析速度以及分析效果
element_fields.name: allowed_columns

element_fields.help_en: The required row filter condition for the current table. If this parameter is not specified, it is ignored. If this parameter is specified, the query condition is appended to all SQL statements that involve this table. Verify the validity of the condition before specifying it
element_fields.help_zh: 当前表必须携带的行过滤条件。若不填写则忽略；若填写，会在所有涉及这个表的SQL语句后拼入查询条件。请注意校验填入条件的合法性
element_fields.name: required_row_filter
